description: This file contains a PHPUnit test case class 'EmployeeEducationDaoTest' which tests various methods of the 'EmployeeEducationDao' class related to employee education data management, including retrieval, deletion, search, save, and update operations. It uses the PHPUnit framework for assertions and tests the Data Access Object (DAO) in the OrangeHRM PIM plugin.

classes.name: EmployeeEducationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for EmployeeEducationDao, testing CRUD operations and search functionality for employee education records.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, instantiates the DAO, and populates test data from YAML fixture.

methods.name: testGetEmployeeEducationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of employee education data by ID and verifies fields.

methods.name: testDeleteEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests deletion of multiple employee education records and verifies the count of deleted records.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests search functionality for employee education records with specific employee number.

methods.name: testSearchEmployeeEducationWithLimit
methods.description: Tests search with limit parameter to restrict number of results.

methods.name: testSaveEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests saving a new employee education record and verifies saved data.

methods.name: testEditEmployeeEducation
methods.description: Tests updating an existing employee education record and verifies updated data.

methods.name: testGetSearchEmployeeEducationsCount
methods.description: Tests retrieval of total count of employee education records matching search parameters.
